items.question: How many parabolic trough collectors does the Shams Solar Power Plant in Abu Dhabi use to generate energy?
items.fact: Shams plant generates energy through 768 parabolic trough collectors

items.question: What tariff per kilowatt-hour did the Al Dhafra Solar PV plant achieve for its solar power?
items.fact: Al Dhafra Solar PV tariff was USD 1.32 per kWh
